abstract: Generative recommenders retrieve items by writing their semantic IDs (SIDs) code by code under trie-constrained beam search, an approach now deployed on large web platforms. Standard autoregressive interfaces pay for the SID length K twice: a history of T items enters the backbone as TK code tokens, and every beam-search step runs through the backbone, so returning B candidates costs O(BK) backbone decode tokens per user. The second cost often dominates, and it grows with the backbone, the SID depth and the candidate budget. We introduce Deco (decoding from concepts), which separates reading the history from writing the identifier. The backbone reads each history item as one fused token and condenses the history once into a compact next-item concept; a light KV-cached decoder conditioned on the concept and the generated prefix runs the entire beam search, while the identifiers, the trie and the autoregressive factorization stay unchanged. The decoder approaches full-backbone accuracy with cross-entropy alone, and distillation improves it further. On seven datasets from e-commerce, movies and music streaming, Deco achieves comparable or better accuracy than both a standard generative recommender and the full-backbone teacher with fused inputs, while delivering 3.2-8.6$\times$ their throughput under a 50 ms p95 latency budget in a production-style serving pipeline. Delegating beam search makes larger candidate pools and models practical: Deco generates 1000 candidates faster than its teacher generates 100, and with a 1.5B-parameter LLM backbone, it matches the 69M-parameter teacher's throughput while achieving higher accuracy.
key_ideas:
🔸 用MLP把每个历史物品的K个SID码嵌入融合为一个token，将输入从T·K压缩到T个token，prefill只做一次。
🔸 骨干最后一层状态经线性映射产生大小固定（如M=2个向量）的下一物品概念，概念是骨干与解码器之间的唯一接口，解码器从不访问历史。
🔸 轻量因果Transformer解码器（默认2层宽256）配合层级输出头，在SID trie内自回归地做beam search，宽beam和深SID的额外计算都留在小解码器中。
🔸 训练可用纯交叉熵（Deco-CE），也可用冻结全骨干教师的层级蒸馏，等价于教师信息引导的标签平滑。
🔸 针对音乐等重复消费场景，加入基于骨干注意力的历史复制指针，与生成分布在SID trie上精确混合，概念与指针分工如语义与情景记忆。
analysis_summary:
🔸 七个数据集上Deco在NDCG@10上超过教师FusedGR约0.5–19%，Deco-flat也全面匹配或超过FlatGR；在BPC-23等外部对比中超过TIGER、RPG、NEZHA等生成式基线。
🔸 服务效率上，BPC-23中beam search占生成时间91%，Deco将搜索从14.9ms降至2.1ms；在50ms p95预算下比FusedGR多服务3.2–7.3倍用户，峰值吞吐提速至8.6倍。
🔸 收益随规模扩大：候选预算从100到1000时Deco仍快于教师在100时的速度且召回三倍；SID深度从2到8时相对教师加速从2.7×增至6.8×；3B LLM骨干下相对FusedGR加速16×，且1.5B骨干比69M教师更快更准。
🔸 消融显示富历史访问（全部物品状态、交叉注意力）无一致增益且延迟最高增加20%；复制指针使Yambda上Deco的NDCG@10从0.079升至0.171，四模型在重复目标上接近。
🔸 轻解码器尺寸不敏感（3.5M–21.6M参数内指标波动约3%），蒸馏带来稳定增益而教师初始化可选；局限包括概念预计算依赖历史变更时机、低重复数据假设等。
personal_view: 基于全文来看，这篇论文的创新点在于把生成式检索中重复的beam search开销从骨干中剥离，用固定大小的概念作为两阶段接口，思路清晰且工程价值显著，尤其是概念仅1KiB可预计算、宽beam与深SID不再触碰骨干的设计，对工业部署很有吸引力。实验覆盖七个数据集、多种骨干规模和外部基线，蒸馏与复制指针的消融也较充分。可能的局限在于：概念是否足以承载复杂长期偏好仍依赖数据集特性，论文自己承认重复消费需要额外指针机制；此外效率对比基于其自建serving管线，通用性有待更多真实流量验证；蒸馏也要求先训练教师，增加训练流程复杂度。
